title: flywheel: orch_pi_models input
description: [DEPRECATED — use flywheel_pi_models instead; removed in v4.0] Pick models for Pi lanes from the live Vercel AI Gateway catalog and usage leaderboard. action="list" ranks tool-capable models by recent gateway token share and returns one AskUserQuestion payload per role in data.questions. action="choose" takes the answers keyed by role, resolves each to a vercel-ai-gateway/<id> model, runs pi auth check, remembers the picks in .pi-flywheel/pi-models.json, and returns data.piModels plus data.piReady.

action.description: list=rank models and build the questions, choose=validate and remember the answers

roles.description: Lanes to ask about with action=list. Deep plan uses ["robustness","ergonomics"]; swarms use ["implementer"] (the default).

picks.description: Required with action=choose. Maps a role to the chosen option label, catalog name, or gateway model id.

refresh.description: Refetch even when the cached catalog is under an hour old.
